dedupe_keys.name: arcep fixed broadband deployment and mobile site data as re published on local open data portals

description: ARCEP fixed broadband deployment and mobile site data, as re-published on local open data portals is a dataset listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by 38 French local portals re-publishing a national dataset. 67 datasets on 38 portals hold the French regulator ARCEP's fixed broadband and fibre deployment by commune, building and shared connection point, and the mobile 2G to 5G site lists, as re-published or filtered to a local area. Coverage: France; each copy is limited to the area of its portal (for example Agglopolys, Blois (Loir-et-Cher), Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis, Aix-en-Provence, Autour de Chenonceaux (Indre-et-Loire)). The copies sit on: aix-en-provence.opendatasoft.com, ccrm41-centrevaldeloire.opendatasoft.com, data.82amenagement.fr, data.ampmetropole.fr, data.blois.agglopolys.fr, data.cannes.com, data.cc-autourdechenonceaux.fr, data.centrevaldeloire.fr and others. Each copy has its own page, description and export. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons-CC0 (http://opendefinition.org/od/1.1/fr/), Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
